mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 6%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, leads to decreased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of quarters with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing demand, S&P 500 forward returns increase over the next 60 trading days due to spillover effects into related sectors.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances with HOUST above its 6mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 1%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 2% YoY) creates an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek inflation hedges.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances with low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS (below -50k jobs), indicating labor market weakness, immediately leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 30% of instances with PAYEMS below -50k, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, RSAFS growth (above 5% YoY) is a leading indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects robust consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS growth above 5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 4-year rolling window.
